scope: Synthetic revision-window residual gain after a supplied monotonic revision event; not R2, autonomous change detection, production promotion, external validity or SNN superiority
task: Use the observable-revision task structure with wholly fresh seeds and episode identities. Training and 768 pre-revision scored episodes use revision 1. A supplied strictly increasing revision ID 2 arrives before the next prediction. True_revision flips every address label; false_revision changes no label. The candidate uses residual updates at rate 0.40 for exactly 1152 successful decisions, capped to absolute delta 0.50, then returns to signed constant updates at rate 0.15. The previous policy uses rate 0.15 in the same window. Fixed controls account for the notification but never change rule. The scalar candidate receives identical addresses and signals and must match candidate predictions exactly. Labels are revealed only after prediction. One frozen execution; no post-result tuning or retry.
failure_policy: Retain negative evidence and stop this revision-gain line if any adoption or resource gate fails. A pass authorizes only structurally held-out evaluation; it is not R2 or production evidence.
